question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

182, 132, 90, 56, ?, 12, 2
solution:
**Logic :** Consecutive number series with difference of 8 is subtracted from each number subsequently. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/547c080d7d2223fc793b360e3637bbab73b11bf1fd68872c861f3824f587d0a3.png] 

Hence, **"30"** is the correct answer.
